name: mtg-api
description: REST API over Matt's Magic: The Gathering collection, on Cloudflare Workers + D1

scripts.test:screens: node scripts/guard.mjs 1200 -- ./apps/gradlew -p apps :androidApp:testDebugUnitTest && node scripts/check-test-count.mjs apps/androidApp/src/sharedTest apps/androidApp/build/test-results/testDebugUnitTest
scripts.test:android: node scripts/guard.mjs 2700 -- ./apps/gradlew -p apps :androidApp:connectedDebugAndroidTest -Pandroid.injected.androidTest.leaveApksInstalledAfterRun=true && node scripts/check-test-count.mjs apps/androidApp/src/sharedTest apps/androidApp/build/outputs/androidTest-results
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:core && npm run test:web && npm run test:screens
